VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S., offering a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design for an affordable big-screen experience.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy, a new title restoring the 2024 version of the game, is set to launch for Meta Quest and PC VR later this month.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple has published technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing its ecosystem for developers.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack has reiterated his $1 million offer to Microsoft to support VR ports of id Software's classic games, aiming to revitalize retro titles.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirmed ongoing development of multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at potential announcements during the upcoming Connect event.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: Squingle Arcade, a fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game featuring hand tracking, is now available for free on Meta Quest.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the theft of trade secrets to advance the AI startup's hardware initiatives.

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-5.6 after receiving government approval, marking a significant advancement in its AI model offerings.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature that labels ads created or edited with AI, enhancing transparency for users on its platforms.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program to host AI data centers in customers' homes, offering incentives for participation.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta is disabling a controversial Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts following public backlash.

AI.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
AI.summary: OpenAI's AGI chief, Fidji Simo, is stepping down to become a part-time advisor due to health issues.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla-led group agrees to buy the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla's group has agreed to purchase the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion, with Khosla needing to divest his 49ers stake.

NFL.title: Aaron Rodgers can become the fifth quarterback in NFL history with 70,000 passing yards
NFL.summary: Aaron Rodgers aims to join the elite group of quarterbacks with 70,000 passing yards in what he has indicated will be his final season.

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility
NFL.summary: Aaron Donald has been spotted working out at the Rams' facility, fueling speculation about a potential return from retirement.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla's wife, Neeru, will be controlling owner of Seahawks
NFL.summary: Neeru Khosla will become the controlling owner of the Seahawks, with her son Neal expected to play a significant role in the organization.

NFL.title: Colts want to "find ways to take some of that workload" off Jonathan Taylor
NFL.summary: The Colts plan to reduce Jonathan Taylor's workload, aiming to manage his carries after two consecutive seasons over 300 attempts.

NFL.title: Bears sign third-round TE Sam Roush to complete draft class signings
NFL.summary: The Bears have officially signed third-round tight end Sam Roush, completing their draft class signings.
